fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects an unexpected process spawning from dns.exe which may indicate activity related to remote code execution or other forms of exploitation as seen in CVE-2020-1350 (SigRed)
fields.name: Unusual Child Process of dns.exe
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\dns.exe" and (not tgt.process.image.path contains "\\conhost.exe")))
